title: Njama Njama and Corn Fufu (Adamu)
author: Imma Adamu (Immaculate Bites)
desc: Blanched nightshade greens (or kale or spinach) cooked with tomatoes, onion, Scotch bonnet and smoked turkey or fish in oil, served with a corn fufu.
longDesc: Njama njama is the author’s name for a popular Cameroon green vegetable, especially in the North West Region (Solanum scabrum, in her notes). The greens are blanched 2–3 minutes in hot water until wilted, cooled, drained and squeezed. Onion is sautéed 2–3 minutes; tomatoes, Scotch bonnet and bouillon are added and cooked, scraping up the browned bits, with the paprika and smoked turkey or fish. After about 10 minutes the greens go in for 2–3 minutes. The page pairs it with a corn fufu (CMR029).
ingredients: 5 pounds nightshade greens or water cress (or 3 pounds frozen kale or spinach)
1/2–1 cup canola oil or palm oil
1/2 pound chopped smoked turkey or fish
1 teaspoon paprika, optional (listed a second time)
1 tablespoon bouillon powder or Maggi cube, optional
steps: Blanch the greens in hot water for 2–3 minutes until wilted. Cool in cold water, drain and squeeze.
Add the tomatoes, Scotch bonnet and bouillon and scrape up the browned bits. Add the paprika, smoked turkey or fish and crayfish if using.
Add the greens and cook 2–3 minutes. Adjust the seasoning. Serve with corn fufu (CMR029).
chefTips: The printed cue for blanching is ‘until wilted’.
Squeeze the blanched greens hard before they go in.
A reader on the page warns that many Solanum species have toxic leaves or fruit — identify the plant.
commonMistakes: Skipping the squeeze so the dish is watery.
Treating the doubled paprika lines as 2 teaspoons — one is marked optional.
healthBenefits: Leafy greens give vitamins and minerals; smoked turkey or fish adds protein.
culturalNote: Adamu writes it is a popular green vegetable ‘especially in the North West Region’. The page prints ‘5 pounds’ of greens for 4–5 servings, which looks large; it is printed as is.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Njama Njama and FuFu’. Byline as printed: ‘Imma Adamu’. Published 30 Jul 2014, last updated 21 May 2021. Yield 4–5. Prep 20 min, cook 30 min, total 50 min. TWO-PASS.
As printed, not fixed: ‘1- teaspoon’ paprika truncated; paprika listed twice; ‘5 pounds’ of fresh greens vs 3 pounds frozen; ‘cray fish’ appears in the method but not in the list.
ABSENT: oil choice (canola vs palm) is printed ‘canola oil palm oil’.
